name: week
title: The integrity week
subtitle: What is overdue, what falls due soon, and what the records say is out of line

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select kind,record,due,detail from v_attention order by due,kind,record

sections.title: Compliance findings
sections.note: Each rule and its source: docs/compliance.md.
sections.sql: select rule,record,issue from v_compliance order by rule,record

sections.title: By site
sections.sql: select s.code site,s.name,count(*) filter (where e.status='in_service') in_service,count(*) filter (where d.internal_days<0 or d.external_days<0) overdue from sites s join equipment e on e.site_id=s.id join v_due d on d.equipment_id=e.id group by s.code,s.name order by s.code

name: register
title: Pressure equipment register
subtitle: Every item, its hazard level, certificate and next inspections

sections.title: Register
sections.sql: select code,site,name,kind,hazard_level,design_pressure_kpa,status,cert_no,cert_expires,next_internal,next_external,valves,open_anomalies from v_register order by site,code

name: corrosion
title: Corrosion and remaining life
subtitle: Wall loss at every monitoring point and what it means for the next internal

sections.title: Shortest remaining life first
sections.note: The higher of the long term and short term rate governs (API 510 7.1.1).
sections.sql: select equipment,cml,location,last_on,last_mm,required_mm,rate_mm_yr,governs,remaining_life_yrs,below_required from v_cml_rates order by below_required desc,remaining_life_yrs nulls last,equipment,cml

sections.title: Next internal and what sets it
sections.sql: select equipment,site,scheme_internal,half_life_internal,next_internal,internal_set_by from v_due where status='in_service' order by next_internal nulls last

name: shutdown
title: Shutdown plan
subtitle: Internal inspections and relief valve tests due in the next twelve months, by site

sections.title: Internals
sections.sql: select site,equipment,name,next_internal,internal_days,internal_set_by from v_due where status='in_service' and internal_days<=365 order by site,next_internal

sections.title: Relief valves
sections.sql: select site,valve,equipment,set_pressure_kpa,next_due,days_left,last_result from v_valves where status='in_service' and days_left<=365 order by site,next_due

sections.title: Open anomalies to close in the outage
sections.sql: select a.code,e.code equipment,a.severity,a.description,a.due_on from anomalies a join equipment e on e.id=a.equipment_id where a.closed_on is null order by a.due_on nulls last
